{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds an in-memory queue and randomized delay to PeerManager for transaction broadcast to improve transaction origin privacy.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Improves transaction origin privacy by decoupling transaction creation from broadcast timing. The author notes the goal is 'increased privacy, by making time-correlation-based tracking more difficult', but as an in-memory-only delay queue for private broadcast, it represents a worthwhile, deferrable privacy enhancement."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the optional `delay_for` parameter to the `sendrawtransaction` RPC method.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends the `sendrawtransaction` interface with an optional parameter. In the RPC category, exposing a new option without broader interface changes or widespread downstream demand is a minor addition."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not modify shared utilities, logging, or cryptographic primitives; the randomized jitter merely consumes existing randomness utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Not a member of utils because the PR does not change shared utility libraries or node-wide infrastructure."
    }
  ],

    "bug_severity": 0,

  }
}
